paras: Koehler's gecko (Ancylodactylus koehleri) is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is native to Central Africa.
The specific name, koehleri, is in honor of Max Köhler who collected the holotype.
A. koehleri is found in Cameroon and Equatorial Guinea, and also in Gabon and Nigeria.
The preferred natural habitat of A. koehleri is forest, at altitudes of 560–1,500 m (1,840–4,920 ft).
